Container.Name: Downsizarr
Container.Overview: Downsizarr batch-transcodes your H264 video library to H265/HEVC to reclaim disk space while preserving quality (libx265 CRF by default, optional NVENC/QSV/VAAPI). Browse your shares from a web GUI, queue small QA batches first, then scale up. Originals are never modified - converted files are written next to the source with a .hevc suffix. Tracks per-file sizes and total space saved over time.

Config.Name: Media Share
Config.Description: Your media share. Read/write required - converted files are written next to the source.

Config.Name: Config / DB
Config.Description: Stores the metrics database and logs.

Config.Name: Output Suffix
Config.Description: Inserted before the extension: Movie.mkv -> Movie.hevc.mkv

Config.Name: Max Concurrent
Config.Description: How many transcodes run at once. Keep at 1 for QA / libx265 slow.

Config.Name: Default Encoder
Config.Description: libx265 (software, best quality), hevc_nvenc, hevc_qsv, or hevc_vaapi

Config.Name: Default CRF
Config.Description: Quality target. Lower = higher quality + larger. 18 is visually transparent.

Config.Name: Intel GPU (QSV/VAAPI)
Config.Description: Optional: pass through the Intel iGPU for hardware encoding (hevc_qsv / hevc_vaapi).
